description: List the workspaces the chosen login's user belongs to and which one that login is scoped to. selected is null while none is chosen; every project and billing call then answers resource_not_found. Ask the customer which workspace to use instead of guessing, then call organization_use.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: organization_list
